text:
elaine (PM): quick idea — propose an "opportunistic headroom" pilot for Dedicated where customers can opt to make a fraction of unused reserved capacity available as short-lived burst credits to other tenants. goal: improve utilization, provide cheaper burst headroom, and validate pricing for exchange.

elaine (PM): MVP asks: opt-in toggle in console, credits minted per-hour up to X% of pool, expiry window, simple billing export, and clear SLA/priority rules. thinking 3 pilot customers.

taylor (Eng): curious about runtime impact — how do we route bursts? preemptible slots? need clear preemption priority so latency-sensitive customers not affected.

sunil (SRE): +1 on preemption policy. we should enforce a hard cap per pool and require defaults: max_burst_pct, preempt_priority, credit_ttl. observability hooks: token-level latency histogram, eviction events.

nora (CS): customer-facing concerns: messaging, opt-in consent, and a rollback path if customers see degraded p95. want a canned email + dashboard widget showing credit exposure.

kevin (Pricing): pricing model options: (A) flat discount per-credit hour (B) revenue share to owner customer (C) bucketed discount tied to utilization. For pilot maybe (A) to keep billing simple. need examples of $ impact.

taylor (Eng): propose an MVP config snippet for policy.

```
policy:
  max_burst_pct: 20        # percent of reserved pool that can be exposed
  credit_ttl_hours: 6     # credits expire after 6h
  preempt_priority: "owner_first"  # owner wins on contention
  per_tenant_burst_limit: 10%  # per-tenant cap when using credits
```

sunil (SRE): that looks reasonable. add a circuit-breaker: if pool p95 latency > threshold for > 5m then auto-revoke credits.

elaine (PM): launch criteria suggestion: 1) no observable p99 regressions in pilot pools for 72h, 2) billing clarity for pilot customers, 3) 3 customers enrolled and using credits at least once, 4) runbook + rollback tested.

nora (CS): add: acceptance from pilot customers on terms + opt-in UI tested.

kevin (Pricing): we'll run a quick revenue sensitivity model. milestone: show 2 pricing options vs baseline by EOW.

taylor (Eng): engineering scope (MVP): API to mint/redeem credits, console toggle + exposure metrics, route decision in router, preemption check, circuit-breaker hook. estimate: 3 sprints for core + 1 sprint for canary/observability.

elaine (PM): ops playbook: default auto-revoke thresholds, owner notification template, grace period for manual reclaim. who owns runbook? @sunil?

sunil (SRE): will draft runbook and oncall alerts. also need tracing tags for credit_id.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary/opportunistic-headroom v1 -> us-west-2 on 2024-05-14T03:30Z (dry-run).

elaine (PM): pilot enrollment: nora to own outreach, taylor + sunil to own rollout, kevin to own pricing experiment.

nora (CS): will draft outreach + consent language and send to 3 candidates by Tue.

kevin (Pricing): will prepare two pricing sheets for pilot and a quick calculator snippet for CS.

taylor (Eng): will put up a short RFC with API shapes and router flow by EOD tomorrow.

elaine (PM): open questions we need answered before kick: 1) exact max_burst_pct for each pool type, 2) whether credits should be transferable between pools, 3) accounting for credits vs reserved usage on invoices.

sunil (SRE): operationally I'd prefer no cross-pool transfer in MVP. simplifies preemption.

elaine (PM): decision log so far: MVP = opt-in exposed credits per-pool, no cross-pool transfer, circuit-breaker, flat per-credit price for pilot.

elaine (PM): action items: [nora] outreach, [taylor] RFC + PR, [sunil] runbook + alerts, [kevin] pricing model, [elaine] pilot success metrics doc. check-ins Tue/Wed. :thumbsup:

nora (CS): :thumbsup: will start outreach list.

taylor (Eng): thanks — I'll include example API response in RFC:

```
{ "credit_id": "c_123", "amount_gpu_hours": 4, "expires_at": "2024-05-14T09:30Z" }
```

elaine (PM): great thread — let's keep thread for decisions and move tactical chatter to the pilot channel once RFC lands.

sunil (SRE): noted. I'll add SLO checks and alert runbook draft to the doc today.

kevin (Pricing): will share sensitivity slides before EOD Friday.

ops-bot: reminder: canary dry-run scheduled in 30m.
